0417Work skills

general-agent

PrimeIntellect/general-agent

Complete multi-turn tool-use tasks in a task-specific tool world, scored against a gold tool-call chain by database state.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • multi-turn tool-use RL
  • state-verified tool tasks

Reward

How it is scored
State check
Signal
Pass or fail

Tasks replay the gold chain and reward an exact final database-hash match or a passing verify(db) check.

How to run it

1. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download PrimeIntellect/general-agent --repo-type dataset --local-dir general-agent

2. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/PrimeIntellect/general-agent --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Verifiers, Harbor. Needs: Read access to PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-envs; verifiers[harbor]>=0.3.1.
